caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, tan-brown textile background with an embroidered scene in the center. In the middle, there is a tree with a beige trunk and branches, filled with multicolored leaves—mainly blue, light green, and brown—and pink fruit or flowers. Winding around the trunk is a black snake. Beneath the tree stand two nude human figures with long, blue hair, one on each side of the tree; the left figure is holding a pink fruit. Surrounding the base of the tree are several animals, including a reddish-brown quadruped, a black quadruped, a blue and white bird, and a light brown animal that resembles a goat. On the left side of the tree is a bush with pink flowers and a bee flying nearby; a similar bush and bee are on the right. Above the tree, on the left, there is a yellow bird in flight, and on the right, a blue bird flying. At the top center above the tree is a butterfly with brownish wings. The overall scene is framed by the natural edges of the embroidered textile, showing some fraying.
title: Adam & Eve Embroidered Picture
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
